title: Tomodachi Game
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Five high school friends are forced into a game that pays off a shared debt but tests their trust in each other. Poor student Yuichi Katagiri turns out to be a master manipulator who reads the rules and opponents, aiming to destroy the organization behind the games.
life_message: A good life is surviving a rigged world by outthinking it, while asking what real friendship is worth.

content.note: Murders and framing in backstory; the lead is said to have killed his adoptive parents (Wikipedia, to verify); tags flag torture and death games.
